name: Fuse whelp
description: a brimstone whelp, a young demon of the Cracked Road the size of a dog, on four stubby clawed legs: cracked black basalt hide with thin orange glowing seams, two stubby charred horns, a big jaw glowing like a furnace, a short rock tail, a fat stick of black road rock strapped to its back with rope, a lit fuse sparking on top of it

poses.stand: standing on four stubby legs, the rock bomb strapped on its back, the fuse sparking
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: exploding in a ball of fire, smoke and rock chunks

idle.action: stands panting, the fuse on its back sparking

move.action: runs flat out forward on its stubby legs, the fuse sparking wildly, staying in the same spot in the frame

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: the fuse burns down and it explodes in a ball of fire, smoke and rock chunks
